seeded.note: Reported, not gated. A seeded split is synthetic (two halves of one event), so the calibrated judgement has no stored answer for it and leaves it undecided without paid calls. A seeded join is a real pair of one organisation's events more than --join-gap-days apart, judged from storage, but its 'different' is an assumption, not a label: misdated copies of one incident lie that far apart (6 of the 17 labelled-same organisation pairs are 707-4,603 days apart), so a join merged at the cut-off is a case to review, not a measured error.
